skill_name: Do research on the history of poverty in the U.S. and summarize your findings.
workflow: The history of poverty in the United States is a long and complex one. In the early years of the nation, poverty was primarily a rural problem, with the vast majority of the population living in rural areas. Many rural populations were struggling with subsistence farming and small industries which were hardly enough to make a living. By the mid 20th century, however, poverty had become a major issue in the cities, thanks to industrialization, immigration, and displacement of rural populations.
